title: P0 harden handoff freshness and fail-closed governance
scope: Handoff integrity, non-Git freshness, proposal expiry, and governance write guards
alternatives: Retain prototype semantics and treat documented weaknesses as operator guidance
impact: Older handoffs and high-risk drafts without expiry become STALE or cannot be approved until regenerated
counter_evidence: Additional guards can impede recovery workflows if legitimate ledger repair is needed
acceptance_criteria: Tampered handoff, changed non-Git file, expired proposal, and corrupted ledger all block takeover or governance writes
evidence_refs: AEP independent review reproduced handoff, non-Git, expiry, and fail-open gaps; USR-20261115 authorizes remediation
rollback_reference: Revert the hardening commit, retain JSONL evidence, and regenerate a legacy handoff only for controlled recovery.
